WITH Balance AS (
SELECT 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BPCS.PeriodStartDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountID AS AccountID
,BPCS.RetailStatementBalanceAmount AS StatementBalanceRetailAmount
,BPCS.CashStatementBalanceAmount AS StatementBalanceCashAmount
,BPCS.RetailStatementBalanceAmount + BPCS.CashStatementBalanceAmount AS StatementBalance
,BPCS.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
[BNKM].[PaymentCardStatementSummary] BPCS
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BPCS.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BPCS.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BPCS.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL
)
select * into dw.factcardsoutstdbal_Balance from Balance;

WITH GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT
	BranchSK,
	BankSK,
	AccountSK,
    AccountId,
	SourceSystemCode,
    MIN(BusinessDateSK) as min_date, 
    CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.factcardsoutstdbal_Balance
WHERE (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
     BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)-- AND BusinessDateSK >= '2023-01-01'
    GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	b.BranchSK,
    b.BankSK,
    b.AccountSK,
    b.AccountID,
	b.SourceSystemCode,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,FullDate,112) AS FullDate2,
    a.FullDate, 
    b.min_date, 
    b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
  WHERE 
    (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
     BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,Distinct_Balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, StatementBalanceRetailAmount,statementbalance, StatementBalanceCashAmount, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm
FROM dw.factcardsoutstdbal_Balance b
WHERE (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
     BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
, join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate)),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm     
,StatementBalanceRetailAmount
,StatementBalanceCashAmount
,StatementBalance
--,IsoCurrencyCode
--,FinancialInstitutionId
--,DemandAmount
--,ISNULL(b.DemandFlowId,a.DemandFlowId) AS DemandFlowId    
--,AmortizationAmount
--,InterestAmount
--,PenaltyAmount
--,CNT
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [StatementBalanceCashAmount] is null AND [StatementBalanceRetailAmount] is null   then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
 --    [StatementBalanceRetailAmount] is null OR [StatementBalanceRetailAmount] = 0 then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
   AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode
 --   AND a.DemandFlowId = b.DemandFlowId

)
select * into dw.factcardsoutstdbal_join_balance from join_balance;
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup into dw.factcardsoutstdbal_rowgrp from dw.factcardsoutstdbal_join_balance;

with final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
--,case when IsoCurrencyCode is not null then IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
--,case when FinancialInstitutionId is not null then FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [StatementBalance] is not null then StatementBalance else first_value(StatementBalance) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end StatementBalance
--,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) end CNT
,case when [StatementBalanceRetailAmount] is not null then StatementBalanceRetailAmount else first_value(StatementBalanceRetailAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end StatementBalanceRetailAmount
,case when [StatementBalanceCashAmount] is not null then StatementBalanceCashAmount else first_value(StatementBalanceCashAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end StatementBalanceCashAmount
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm                           
from dw.factcardsoutstdbal_rowgrp) 

select * into dw.factcardsoutstdbal_final_balance from final_balance;

INSERT INTO DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance_PBIen
(
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,StatementBalanceRetailAmount_Original
,StatementBalanceCashAmount_Original
,StatementBalance_Original
,Currency_Original
,Currency_Target
,PesoConversionRate
,StatementBalanceRetailAmount
,StatementBalanceCashAmount
,StatementBalance
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
a.BusinessDateSK
,a.BranchSK
,a.BankSK
,a.AccountSK
,a.AccountId
,a.StatementBalanceRetailAmount AS StatementBalanceRetailAmount_Original
,a.StatementBalanceCashAmount AS StatementBalanceCashAmount_Original
,a.StatementBalance AS StatementBalance_Original
,'PHP' AS Currency_Original
,'PHP' AS Currency_Target
,1.00 AS PesoConversionRate
,a.StatementBalanceRetailAmount
,a.StatementBalanceCashAmount
,a.StatementBalance
,a.SourceSystemCode
,a.WorkFlowId
,a.TaskRunId
,a.InsertDttm
FROM dw.factcardsoutstdbal_final_balance a
